attribution: NASA POWER daily point data; reservoir boundaries from CONAE / Government of San Luis

observed.note: The view shows complete observed months from 2016 through the latest common complete month. Trend calculations use all complete observed months since 2002. Partial current months are excluded.

projection.model: Monthly seasonal regression, evaluated against calendar-month historical averages using rolling five-year holdouts.
projection.uncertainty: The band uses the 10th–90th percentiles of rolling-validation residuals by calendar month; it is an empirical variability range, not a guaranteed confidence interval.
projection.limitation: NASA POWER CMIP6 Projection API returned fill values for San Luis cells in validation queries. This demo uses a separately labelled historical-data regression estimate. EVLAND is observed-only and is not projected.

resolution: Nearest POWER cell; effective joint meteorological grid approximately 0.5 x 0.625 degrees
note: These are climate series for the nearest cell to each reservoir outline centroid, not reservoir level, volume, inflow, or storage measurements.
